RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 20

An all-female panel selecting a female candidate is not evidence of unlawful bias. In local government, panel composition typically reflects existing department heads and HR personnel rather than an agenda. For director-level roles, executive competencies—such as public consultation, political acuity, and leadership style—often outweigh technical credentials or degrees.

Raising allegations of sex discrimination without concrete proof, such as inappropriate interview questions or documented procedural breaches, will appear unfounded and likely harm your professional reputation within municipal networks. 

Instead, send a polite follow-up request for feedback. Two weeks is common for municipal administrative timelines. Keep interactions professional and focus on constructive takeaways.
